settings.breakpoints: S/M/L/XL/XXL used throughout; values not yet defined as variables

fileWideNotes: Colors page is typed text, not variables, and disagrees with the variables in places (e.g. Chattanooga Green: page #00874E / #008E52, variable 'Chattanooga Green' #127E4A and 'Colors/Chattanooga Greens/Chattanooga Green' #00874E).

Two variable naming schemes coexist: older (Spacing/spacing-xs, Radius/radius-rounded, Colors/...) and newer on the refactored Button (Scale/Padding/p-md, Scale/Radius/rad-lg, Neutral/800, Border/...). Pick one before tokens are published.
Stray variable 'Primary/Color' #7749F8 appears on input fields (looks like a UI-kit default).
Several components are duplicated between the Components page and the dedicated Buttons/Forms pages.
No dark theme variable mode found; 'Dark/Light/On Dark' are variants on individual components.
Variable 'Buttons/Primary/Fill/Default' is #FFFFFF while the primary button's visible fill is Border/Button/button-primary #FFB949; button variables look stale or mis-assigned.
Icons render as empty boxes until `npm run fetch:figma-assets` is run (Figma asset links issued 2026-11-06, expire after 7 days).
Responsive breakpoint assumed at 768px (src/styles/responsive.css) until S/M/L/XL/XXL widths are defined.
Token audit not yet run on saved design context: batch 1 design context wasn't saved to disk (the checks were added after). The next sync check re-reads it for built components.

components.name: Button
notes: Built from 'Button - Refactored' (Buttons page)
Outline on dark has no Focus or Disabled design; code uses an ADA ring and grey stroke, needs design review
Ghost has no Small size in Figma
Tinted fills (6% ADA, 10% green, 10% grey) are raw rgba in Figma, not variables; code derives them from tokens with color-mix()
Label font Gabarito; button text stays 16px at both sizes in this set (the older Button Master uses 14px 'Small Screen/Button Link')

components.name: Input Field
notes: Field radius is a raw 6px in Figma (Focus state uses 4px radius-minimal); kept as designed, needs a token
Focus in Figma grows the field by 8px (ring inside the layout); code draws the ring outside to avoid layout shift — intentional deviation
Required asterisk uses 'Brick Red/500' #DB4240, a variable outside the documented palette
'Active' state treated as hover
'Screen' encodes desktop/mobile; implement as responsive CSS, not a prop
